reading.body:
Rack59 Data Center occupies a commercial address in Oklahoma City and is listed as a data center facility, but the operator has published no specifications for power capacity, cooling, or IT load. No megawatt rating appears in any source this site has read. Oklahoma has nine mapped data center facilities on record, none with published power specifications, making Rack59's capacity relative to other sites in the state unknown.

Without published power or density figures, this site cannot be assessed as a node in AI infrastructure scaling. The address resolves to a commercial suite, which may indicate a small or co-located operation, but no evidence in the data distinguishes the facility's actual size, ownership, or technical scope. The operator's website, if one exists, was not reached during research.

Oklahoma has no published data center capacity registered with this project. Rack59 cannot be ranked against peers in the state because no comparable figures exist. To determine whether this campus matters to AI infrastructure, a reader would need to contact the operator directly for power and cooling specifications, or rely on third-party measurement of the grid load it draws.
